tasks.currentResult: Passed after three audit corrections. A 2026-08-10 live read-only Vercel review corrected one false fixture assumption: GET /v9/projects/:id binds targets.production through the already-decoded outer project id and does not repeat projectId inside the nested deployment. The current decoder rejects a wrong outer project and binds that verified identity to the nested target. A 2026-08-13 strict Effect audit replaced Bun.spawn, raw Promise orchestration, ambient process.env copying, and two response-reader exceptions with the installed beta.101 scoped ChildProcessSpawner and Stream boundary; the application command supplies BunServices.layer, while a controlled spawner Layer proves live payload decoding without a real process. Direct Bun process spawning and ambient environment access are boundary-audit failures. The same audit then replaced typed-error-only compensation with an uninterruptible Effect.onExit rollback finalizer, and deterministic after-write interruption and defect fixtures prove agent-then-proxy restoration. Hosted mutation remains separately gated.
